extras.name: Iris (shaders)
extras.description: Shader support: real shadows, light and water. Pick a shader pack below.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Then pick **Shaders: Light or Full** in the same tab. In game, Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs changes the pack too.

extras.name: Light shaders (MakeUp Ultra Fast)
extras.description: Soft shadows and nicer water, made for slower PCs.
extras.howTo: Needs Iris. In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch on Iris, choose **Shaders: Light** and press **Apply**. Try this first on a laptop or an older graphics card.

extras.name: Full shaders (Complementary Reimagined)
extras.description: The full look. Needs a proper graphics card.
extras.howTo: Needs Iris. In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch on Iris, choose **Shaders: Full** and press **Apply**. If the game gets choppy, go back to Light.

extras.name: Not Enough Animations
extras.description: Proper third-person animations: eating, climbing ladders, holding maps.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up: press **F5** to see yourself in third person.

extras.name: 3D Skin Layers
extras.description: The outer layer of player skins drawn in 3D instead of flat.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up: hats, jackets and sleeves on skins stand out in 3D.

extras.name: Falling Leaves
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up.

extras.name: Particle Rain
extras.description: Rain and snow as particles, with splashes, mist and fog.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up: you'll see it the next time it rains.

extras.name: Sound Physics Remastered
extras.description: Echo in caves, muffled sound through walls, voice chat too.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up: caves echo and walls muffle sound, voice chat included.

extras.name: Fresh Animations
extras.description: Mobs blink, breathe and move naturally. Brings EMF and ETF with it.
extras.howTo: In the Deepslate Works app (the window that opens when you press Play), open **Extras**, switch it on and press **Apply**. Nothing to set up: it brings Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features with it.
